evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and directly modifies the HTTP server in src/httpserver.cpp and RPC bind tests.
rationale: Fixes a local RPC credential leak that allows an attacker to hijack bitcoind. As demonstrated in test f103468712 and confirmed by reviewers, when IPv4 bind fails but IPv6 succeeds, the server generates cookie credentials that bitcoin-cli sends in plaintext to the foreign process occupying the default IPv4 port.
